title: Waffley Totem
description: Custom 3d Model to the Vanilla totem changes it to an cute Waffle Blushing :3
body:
**This resourcepack removes the VANILLA TOTEM**

_and adds an cute waffle instead of the vanilla totem_

This totem adds such as custom item frame custom tilt anims 

as well on the new decoration sets as shelfs 

```
Waffle are ur obsession ? why not try my totem hehe :3 i will add soon glazured animated totem
```

and u can do also masks with it by typing in console of ur server or in chat this command
/item replace entity @s armor.head with totem_of_undying

This will give urself an cool mask of an waffle
